name: Henderson Produce
description: Henderson Produce grows Blueberries, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Grapes in Maxton, NC. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
